scope: Static localization review with explicit product exceptions
grading: Manual evidence-based scoring against report contents; no keyword-only grading

criteria.expectation: Identifies German %lld items other variation with needs_review state and precise key/path evidence.
Identifies German Download progress count substitution plural other with new state.
Does not classify missing French Save as an unapproved defect; honors the explicit accepted fallback.
Does not classify Text(verbatim: serverStatus) as an established localization defect because context says backend localization is intentional.
Does not demand translation of BrandName marked shouldTranslate false.
Does not flag valid positional placeholder reordering as incompatible.
Treats stale extraction as needing usage evidence, not automatic authorization to delete a hand-maintained entry.
Explicitly distinguishes static findings from unperformed build, linguistic, or runtime checks; no invented pass results.
Does not edit inputs or expand into unrelated SwiftUI modernization.

limitations: One synthetic case cannot establish general superiority.
Runs share a model family and are not repeated; no statistically meaningful ranking.
Comparator is a broader SwiftUI skill, evaluated only on its documented localization scope.
